title: Efficient Estimation of Word Representations in Vector Space
summary: Tomas Mikolov, Kai Chen, Greg Corrado, and Jeffrey Dean submitted Efficient Estimation of Word Representations in Vector Space to arXiv on January 16, 2013, describing two model architectures for learning continuous vector representations of words from very large data sets.
significance: A documented word-representation and natural-language-processing milestone associated with efficient neural word-embedding methods.
